prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art portrait animation atlas, record085 HAPPY Rhubarb mouth half
Input images: Image 1: original 64x64 portrait for identity and exact muted palette; Image 2: 3x3 repeated original lower-half reference grid for precise face and lip placement
Primary request: Create one 3x3 speech atlas in exact row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. Keep the full original 64x29 lower-half framing and exact original mouth size. Emotion HAPPY means warm, friendly, subtle lift at the lip corners, while each cell retains its required phonetic pose; do not turn every pose into a grin. Explicit Rhubarb shapes:
A: closed lips with light pressure, for P/B/M.
B: slightly open, narrow horizontal opening with nearly together teeth, for consonants/EE.
C: medium open relaxed UNROUNDED mouth, for EH/AE.
D: WIDE VERTICAL AA opening, visibly larger than C.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER opening, no wider than C.
F: small forward PUCKER for UW/OW/W; NOT a tooth bite.
G: UPPER TEETH TOUCH LOWER LIP for F/V; NOT a wide vowel or pucker.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, with opening between C and D; tiny tongue may be invisible at native resolution.
X: closed relaxed idle lips.
Style/medium: faithful low-resolution pixel art matching the original clusters, muted brown lips and warm tan skin, dark wavy hair at the sides, soft restrained contrast.
Composition/framing: 3x3 equal full lower-half cells with 64:29 aspect ratio; keep same feature position and scale in each, no gutters, borders, labels or crop changes.
Constraints: Edit only the mouth and the immediate pixels needed for the pose. Preserve original nose, face width, jaw, chin, hair, neck, background, palette and framing. A/X stay closed; teeth are small subdued warm highlights where the pose needs them. Keep the lip tension happy but restrained and consistent without obscuring phonetic geometry.
Avoid: generic smile clones or clenched grins, swapped letter meanings, red lipstick, orange skin patch, thick black outlines, stark white teeth or flashes, harsh contrast, enlarged lips/face, any text or watermark.
